parser_scope.EXP-590: fNNr/v with optional numbered subfolio suffix, plus fRos

null_model: Independent within-line exchangeability: each line's first token is drawn uniformly from its observed token multiset. Exact Poisson-binomial upper tails with Holm correction over the three historically selected variants.
limitations: The three-word family was selected in earlier exploratory work; Holm correction covers these variants only, not historical target selection or all prior analyses.
The null preserves each line's token multiset but discards order; it is not a language or random-text control.
ZL3b is one transcription of one manuscript; this audit establishes no semantics or decipherment.
The parser reproduces the two archived line patterns and tokenization; it is not a full independent IVTFF conformance audit.
These exact-tail calculations are a new sensitivity analysis and do not overwrite either frozen experiment archive.
